provenance.rule: EXP-NEXT identifiers are new authoritative post-merge identifiers and do not claim to reproduce the lost EXP-2.7–EXP-2.10 roadmap.

sequence.title: Registry ABI/descriptor release provenance
sequence.objective: Close the remaining repository-side Registry descriptor/protocol-decoding provenance gap without claiming live Registry authority.
concrete_implementation_tasks: Inventory the exact ABI/descriptor inputs used by 420Indexer Registry decoding and Explorer protocol/version presentation.
Replace any implicit or source-only descriptor assumptions with deterministic pinned artifact/descriptor inputs suitable for release qualification.
Record descriptor hashes and the source contract/artifact/version relationships that produced them.
Prove current and historical Registry version/event decoding against deterministic fixtures representing activation, replacement and deprecation.
Keep direct canonical Registry reads and Indexer projections explicitly distinct; repository fixtures may model the canonical side but do not establish live target-network publication.
required_tests: descriptor build reproducibility test from pinned repository inputs
negative_fail_closed_cases: attempt to treat Indexer projection as canonical Registry authority
exact_head_ci_requirements: Run relevant Indexer decoder tests, Explorer Registry tests and retained EXP-2.6 verifier on the final evidence-recording head.
Evidence commit itself must pass; stop after the COMPLETE head is green.
audit_evidence_artifacts: new dedicated audit JSON/MD for EXP-NEXT.1
workflow artifact containing exact head and test summary
completion_conditions: All release-path descriptor inputs are deterministic and pinned.
Final evidence-recording head passes required exact-head CI.

sequence.title: Transaction-fee and raw-event browser presentation
sequence.objective: Complete the repository frontend workflows whose backing service/API data was qualified in EXP-2.1 and EXP-2.5.
dependencies: EXP-NEXT.1 or an explicitly independent reconciled branch
concrete_implementation_tasks: Render gas used, effective gas price and actual fee as distinct transaction fields with exact integer-safe formatting.
Render raw transaction input/value for failed-call inspection without hiding canonical raw values behind decoded labels.
Render complete event emitting address, log index, all topics and raw data on transaction/block event views.
Preserve block hash, transaction hash, chain and log-position provenance in the UI.
Add safe long-hex presentation/copy affordances without truncating the underlying inspectable value.
Update workflow evidence for EXP-WF-003 and EXP-WF-013.
negative_fail_closed_cases: malformed topic/data/address received by presentation layer
silent clipping that changes inspectable raw value
decoded label presented as authoritative when raw data disagrees
exact_head_ci_requirements: Retain EXP-2.1, EXP-2.5 and Explorer service/API verifiers.
Run repository frontend tests on final evidence-recording head.
audit_evidence_artifacts: new dedicated audit JSON/MD for EXP-NEXT.2
explicit_scope_exclusions: ABI-decoded semantic correctness beyond any separately qualified decoder
completion_conditions: Fee and raw-event workflows are complete in repository UI source/tests.
Final evidence-recording head passes exact-head CI.

sequence.title: Consensus/producer and cross-resource browser workflow closeout
sequence.objective: Finish repository UI navigation and security coverage for producer/validator, Registry, contract, address, asset and troubleshooting workflows.
concrete_implementation_tasks: Render historical producer/proposer provenance in block detail using the already-qualified repository trace data.
Provide deterministic navigation from producer/validator context to block/consensus detail without inventing canonical identity.
Qualify Registry service/version to implementation-contract navigation.
Qualify address, asset-transfer, contract-deployment and troubleshooting cross-resource navigation required by the frozen workflow matrix.
Add explicit unsafe/untrusted metadata, link and raw-log rendering security tests.
Reconcile workflow matrix dispositions so repository UI work is marked complete while live evidence remains pending.
negative_fail_closed_cases: wrong-chain or stale data shown without degraded state
exact_head_ci_requirements: Retain EXP-2.3, EXP-2.4 and EXP-2.6 verifiers plus frontend regression.
Final COMPLETE evidence commit must itself pass.
audit_evidence_artifacts: new dedicated audit JSON/MD for EXP-NEXT.3
completion_conditions: All mandatory repository-side browser workflows have deterministic tests.
Final evidence-recording head passes exact-head CI.

sequence.title: Production-equivalent deployment, live integration and recovery qualification
sequence.objective: Qualify the already-built Explorer/Indexer stack against approved target-network infrastructure and production-equivalent deployment conditions.
dependencies: approved target-network execution and consensus sources
concrete_implementation_tasks: Deploy qualified 420Indexer and 420Explorer backend/frontend to non-placeholder production-equivalent endpoints.
Bind Indexer to approved chain ID 420 execution source and approved consensus provider.
Verify ProtocolRegistry runtime code/hash and authorized service/version publication.
Exercise every required Explorer-to-Indexer route with representative data.
Compare indexed block/transaction/receipt/log/Registry/consensus data to approved canonical sources.
Run restart/resume, RPC outage, stale-data, provider-unavailable, bounded reorg and rebuild scenarios.
Record live block-to-producer and fee/event workflow witnesses.
exact_head_ci_requirements: Pin exact release-candidate SHA and deployed artifact identity.
All live qualification records must identify exact candidate and endpoints.
Any candidate change invalidates prior exact-head qualification.
explicit_scope_exclusions: No mainnet/Genesis-ready claim until final acceptance closeout.
No canonical authority assigned to Explorer or Indexer.
completion_conditions: All Genesis-blocking deployment/live/recovery findings are closed or explicitly dispositioned by authoritative criteria.
Production-equivalent end-to-end workflows pass on the exact release candidate.

sequence.title: Final Genesis acceptance and release closeout
sequence.objective: Make the final evidence-based Genesis qualification decision for 420Explorer without carrying unresolved mandatory criteria.
dependencies: all mandatory AC-1 through AC-9 evidence available
concrete_implementation_tasks: Freeze exact release-candidate SHA and complete required-test inventory.
Reconcile every mandatory requirement, workflow, finding and acceptance criterion to final evidence.
Verify all Genesis-blocking findings are closed.
Record workflow run IDs, commands, artifact digests and any explicit non-applicable rationale.
Publish final AC-1 through AC-10 evidence index and closeout record.
Do not infer readiness from repository implementation alone.
negative_fail_closed_cases: any mandatory acceptance criterion remains unverified
evidence from a different SHA is substituted
repository-only evidence used to claim live qualification
exact_head_ci_requirements: Final closeout commit itself must pass the complete mandatory suite.
No further evidence-only commit after the green COMPLETE head unless substantive content changes.
explicit_scope_exclusions: optional 420 Verify presentation integration unless separately promoted by authoritative scope decision
completion_conditions: Exact release candidate and deployed stack are fully evidenced.
Final closeout record explicitly states the supported qualification scope.
